# BAD-012 — Bring back the collab invite link as an https link into the web app's join front door

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 42 (added 2026-08-25). The desktop's collab "Copy link" button was removed because it copied badtakes://collab/<code>: the scheme is registered only in a packaged build, most places an invite gets pasted (Slack, iMessage, Discord, mail) do not linkify a custom scheme, and a recipient without Bad Takes gets nothing. The icon button that copies the bare code stays.

What changed since the TODO was written: the https front door already exists. The web app honours my.badtakes.io/?join=BT-XXXXXX (web/collabweb.js, maybeApplyInviteFromUrl and applyCollabInvite): it opens the Collabs tab with the code filled in and waits for the person to press Join. So the TODO's proposed site/join page may be unnecessary.

Decision for Eric: copy https://my.badtakes.io/?join=<code> directly (everyone lands in the web app, desktop users included), or add a small badtakes.io page that first tries badtakes://collab/<code> and falls back to the web app and the download links.

Then restore the button in renderer/index.html and renderer/app.js; copyCollab() still exists and takes the second caller unchanged. The badtakes:// handler and Collab.parseInviteUrl stay as they are. If a scheme hop is added, verify on a packaged build per docs/RELEASING.md (lsregister reset, then a cold and a warm open of badtakes://collab/BT-XXXXXX). Collab needs sign-in on the web (BAD-002), so check a signed-out visitor landing on the link gets a sensible path through sign-in and back to the invite.
